## Hypothesis

Testing fixed -8%/+30% exit parameters with 1-2 DTE options to evaluate edge capture on J anchor days. The hypothesis is that this exit strategy improves consistency on winner days while avoiding losses on loser days relative to the baseline engine.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** Uses the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence) as defined in the playbook.
- **DTE:** Restricts to 1-2 days to expiration (instead of 0DTE) to reduce theta decay and improve fill quality.
- **Exit:** Fixed -8% premium stop (catastrophe cap) and +30% TP1 (take profit 1), with chandelier profit-lock trailing 15% after TP1. Time stop at 15:50 ET.
- **Position sizing:** 3 contracts minimum (2 TP + 1 runner) per risk-rules.md, scaled by account equity.
